t: The Nebo Blueline Flex Rechargeable LED Handheld Torch delivers high-intensity lighting for demanding trade environments. Producing up to 2600lm with a 260m beam, this durable aluminium torch features various light modes, 5x adjustable zoom, and Flex-Power Technology. Built for site and outdoor use, it is IPX7 water-resistant, drop impact-resistant, and equipped with a USB-C charging port and integrated power bank for on-the-go charging. Designed for reliability and versatility across all working conditions. Run time varies depending on selected light mode: High (2600lm for 2 hours), Medium (1300lm for 4 hours), and Low (260lm for 12 hours). Features Flex-Power Technology but can also operate on 6 x AAA batteries.
